body.message:
Hi, thank you for your transparency. I just want to be honest as well  I had a bad experience recently with another place. They told me I could stay long-term and even mentioned residents who stayed 12 months, but in reality I was only able to stay 2 months. It was quite a shock for me.
I have a 3-year-old son, so I really can’t keep moving from one place to another in Dubai. It’s not stable for him at all. I’m looking for something truly secure and long-term.
I can even show you the previous conversation if needed, just so you understand my concern.
